name: status-bar
description: Enhances Claude Code's status bar with a clickable, configurable view of the session: folder, branch, model, effort, context and usage limits.

showFolder.title: Show folder
showFolder.description: Show the current folder on the left of the row.

showBranch.title: Show branch
showBranch.description: Show the current git branch next to the folder.

showModel.title: Show model
showModel.description: Show the current model on the right of the row.

showEffort.title: Show effort
showEffort.description: Show the reasoning effort next to the model.

showContext.title: Show context
showContext.description: Show how much of the context window is used.

showUsage.title: Show usage limits
showUsage.description: Show the 5-hour and 7-day usage limit windows.

showContextBar.title: Show context bar
showContextBar.description: Draw a bar next to the context percentage in the row.

showUsageBars.title: Show usage bars
showUsageBars.description: Draw a bar next to each usage limit percentage in the row.

showContextLabel.title: Show context label
showContextLabel.description: Lead the context figure with the word Context.

showUsageLabel.title: Show usage label
showUsageLabel.description: Lead the usage limit figures with the word Usage.

contextWarningPercent.title: Context warning threshold
contextWarningPercent.description: Context percentage from which the warning color is used.

contextCriticalPercent.title: Context critical threshold
contextCriticalPercent.description: Context percentage from which the critical color is used.

usageWarningPercent.title: Usage warning threshold
usageWarningPercent.description: Usage limit percentage from which the warning color is used.

usageCriticalPercent.title: Usage critical threshold
usageCriticalPercent.description: Usage limit percentage from which the critical color is used.

pathColor.title: Folder color
pathColor.description: Color of the folder path, as a hex value or a color name.

branchColor.title: Branch color
branchColor.description: Color of the git branch, as a hex value or a color name.

modelColor.title: Model color
modelColor.description: Color of the model name, as a hex value or a color name.

effortColor.title: Effort color
effortColor.description: Color of the reasoning effort, as a hex value or a color name.

mutedColor.title: Muted color
mutedColor.description: Color of secondary details, such as token counts and reset times, as a hex value or a color name.

normalColor.title: Normal level color
normalColor.description: Color of a figure below its warning threshold, as a hex value or a color name.

warningColor.title: Warning level color
warningColor.description: Color of a figure between its warning and critical thresholds, as a hex value or a color name.

criticalColor.title: Critical level color
criticalColor.description: Color of a figure at or above its critical threshold, as a hex value or a color name.
